newsitem.title: SPAIN: BCH, Rothschild say reach private banking agrement.
newsitem.headline: BCH, Rothschild say reach private banking agrement.

text.p: Spain's Central Hispano banking group (BCH) and British merchant bank Rothschild said they had reached a strategic private banking services deal on Thursday.

"The Central Hispano and the Rothschild groups have reached a strategic agreement for the joint development of the private banking services of the Central Hispano group. The agreement will have a worldwide scope and will be developed in two fields, one Spanish and one international."
